evidence.source: pret/pokefirered@ce6406d8 data/scripts/pokemon_mansion.inc: PokemonMansion_1F_OnLoad calls PokemonMansion_EventScript_PressSwitch_1F while FLAG_POKEMON_MANSION_SWITCH_STATE is set, which redraws this gate's tiles (barrier to open floor: `setmetatile` with collision 0); PokemonMansion_1F_EventScript_Statue (bg_event) calls PokemonMansion_EventScript_SecretSwitch: on yes it sets FLAG_POKEMON_MANSION_SWITCH_STATE and runs PressSwitch_1F when the flag was clear, else clears it and runs ResetSwitch_1F (the blockdata state). The flag is shared by all four floors, so one press moves every floor's gates
evidence.toggles_by: face a statue and press A, answer yes: [5, 5] from [5, 6] facing north. Every press flips the flag
evidence.state: closed with the switch off, open with it on
